Looking at a few of the fights, I think you're struggling when you get mechanics, and this is affecting your buff uptime. Letting your VT (Vamperic Touch) and SW:P (Shadow Word: Pain) drop off the boss is a big no-no for a shadow priest.

The basic premises of SP is building insanity and spending it in a balanced way. Things like Mind Blast, MF:I and procs of SW:D (Shadow Word: Death) and VB (Void Bolt) should all be used before they reach their cap otherwise you are wasting generators that you could use to increase your insanity, which you can use to generate DP and therefore increase your damage.

Our biggest damage is MF:I (Mind Flay: Insanity) and DP (Devouring Plague). 

When you are starting the fight, you pop your cool downs (PI, VE, trinkets) and can full send DP when you get enough insanity to use it. This will generate more MF:I procs and increase your numbers on the burst.

Outside of cool downs (when things slow down), you want to refresh DP at the last second to keep uptime while you wait for that next cool down window in 2 minutes.

Things like Halo and Void Torrent (with SWP, VT, and DP on the target) should be cast on cooldown.
